newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon cuts Agan EPS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon cuts Agan EPS.

text.p: Salomon Brothers lowered its 1997 earnings per share estimate for Agan Chemical Manufacturers Ltd to $1.94 from $1.96 after the Israeli company reported lower than expected first quarter earnings.
Salomon maintained its estimate of $2.17 a share in 1998.
Agan earned $0.68 a share in the first quarter, down from $0.77 a year earlier and below Salomon's $0.78 estimate.

"The decline in profitability stems from high operational expenses associated with recently acquired Latin American agrochemical manufacturers and distributors," analyst Victor Halpert said in a report released on Sunday.
The company intends to cut some of these costs, mainly through the integration of selling, general and administrative expenses and a steady reduction in the cost of raw materials, Halpert noted.

The company will benefit in the third and fourth quarters from seasonality, since more than 75 percent of its Latin American sales take place between August and December. Agan will also benefit in the second half from long-term supply contracts in North America.
Salomon Brothers rates the shares a buy.
